fields.description:
## Outcome

Create a reviewable current-state + desired-state WagerTech access matrix before any broad security metadata redesign.

## First pass

Use Jira as the source of business requirements and Salesforce metadata as the source of current configuration.

Review known access/security tickets including:

* WAGR-37
* WAGR-436
* WAGR-401
* WAGR-431
* WAGR-154
* WAGR-94
* WAGR-59
* WAGR-288
* other WAGR tickets containing explicit persona / access requirements

Retrieve current metadata for:

* Profiles
* Permission Sets
* Permission Set Groups
* object CRUD
* field permissions
* relevant system permissions
* page layouts / assignments
* Lightning record pages / Dynamic Forms where relevant

## Deliverable

Produce an access matrix that distinguishes:

* Persona
* Object / field / action
* Object CRUD
* FLS
* Standard UI editability
* Guided Flow access
* Custom / special permission
* Current state
* Proposed desired state
* Source Jira ticket
* Confidence / open question

Do not silently resolve conflicts between older implementation proposals and current Flow dependencies. Flag them for Kobi / Taryn review.

## Gate

No broad metadata changes should be generated from this task until the matrix has been reviewed and approved.

Working plan: https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/268730374/WagerTech+Access+Permission+Model+Working+Plan
fields.summary: Consolidate WagerTech access requirements and produce persona access matrix
